items.title: Why You Can’t Run That AI Model
items.snippet: Why can't you run an AI model even when you have enough storage? Because an AI model is just billions of numbers, and "8B" means 8 billion parameters, not 8 gigabytes. At full precision (16 bits each), those 8 billion numbers take about 16GB. Compress them to 4 bits each, called quantization, and you're down to roughly 4GB plus some overhead.
